needs.proposedSignature: AltCostId += 'overload' (augment AltCostIdRegistry from the family module): { id: 'overload', label: 'overload', cost: AbilityCost, from: 'hand', retarget: 'each' }. Engine: a spell whose castWith.id === 'overload' requires no targets (legal.ts ownTargetSpecs returns none for it) and, on resolution, every TargetSpec in its effects is applied as a for-each over that spec's own filter/controller restriction instead of a chosen target. Tooling: COVER_RULES.altCosts gains the anchored shape /^overload (\{.+\})$/ whose value check is cost.mana.raw === the printed symbols, and render.ts KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS['overload'] = 'you may cast this spell for its overload cost. if you do, change "target" in its text to "each"'.
needs.semantics: Overload is two static abilities that function while the spell is on the stack: an alternative cost, plus a text-changing effect replacing each instance of 'target' with 'each' - the overloaded spell chooses no targets and affects every object the original target spec described, including objects that could not have been legally targeted. Without it no declaration exists for a script to carry, no covers shape matches the printed line, and the round trip has no rules text, so every overload card scores 0 and can never be verified.
